message: Unexpected exception occurred in Metalama: {0} Exception details are in '{1}'. Please report this issue at https://www.postsharp.net/support and attach this file to the ticket. You may want to remove sensitive data from the report.
rationale: The string concatenation in GeneralDiagnosticDescriptors.cs produces a double space before 'Please' ("'{1}'. " + " Please"). The crash report written by CompileTimeExceptionHandler.ReportException can contain the full text of a source file, so the privacy advice that LAMA0001 gives for the same report is missing here.
